components.name: Apply system arrow
components.description: Panel approximation of the native bordered-prominent action; actual metrics and focus are macOS-owned.
components.css: .ds-apply { font: 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; background: rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7%); color: white; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; } .ds-apply:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-apply:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7% / .5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-apply:active { filter: brightness(.95); }

components.name: Restore system pointer
components.description: Panel approximation of the native secondary action; platform rendering remains authoritative.
components.css: .ds-restore { font: 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; background: rgb(100% 99.2% 97.3%); color: rgb(17.6% 14.1% 25.1%); border: 1px solid #bbb; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; } .ds-restore:hover { filter: brightness(.98); } .ds-restore:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7% / .5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-restore:active { filter: brightness(.95); }

components.name: Search cursor sets
components.description: Light-appearance field specimen; native focus is authoritative.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" aria-label="Search cursor sets" placeholder="Find a cursor set">
components.css: .ds-search { font: 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgb(17.6% 14.1% 25.1%); background: rgb(100% 99.2% 97.3%); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: rgb(39.6% 33.7% 43.5%); } .ds-search:hover { outline: 1px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7% / .3); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7%); }

components.name: Selected set row
components.description: Selection fill, type, count, and checkmark; source artwork is omitted in this panel specimen.
components.css: .ds-set { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 196px; text-align: left; font: 600 13px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgb(17.6% 14.1% 25.1%); background: rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7% / .13); border: 0; padding: 9px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-count { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: rgb(39.6% 33.7% 43.5%); } .ds-set:hover { filter: brightness(.98); } .ds-set:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7%); } .ds-set:active { filter: brightness(.95); }

components.name: Selected cursor tile
components.description: Light-preview tile specimen with neutral inline arrow symbol; actual imported/native artwork renders through NSImage.
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; width: 150px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 10px; border: 2px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7%); border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(100% 97.3% 91.4%); color: rgb(17.6% 14.1% 25.1%); font: 500 12px -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-art { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 48px; font-size: 34px; } .ds-detail { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; opacity: .78; } .ds-check { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; color: rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7%); } .ds-tile:hover { filter: brightness(.99); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(54.9% 42% 84.7%); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tile:active { filter: brightness(.96); }

narrative.northStar: A pocket collection of pointer pals
narrative.overview:
A pocket collection of pointer pals, grounded in a dependable Mac utility. Warm cream, pale lavender, mint, and rose give the cursor artwork room to feel personal. The original cat-eared octopus brings a small face and rounded tentacles to the brand mark.

Native macOS controls, system type, direct selection, and readable status keep the work calm and precise. Character supports browsing and previewing; explicit Apply and visible Restore make the scope understandable.
keyCharacteristics: Warm pastel surfaces with lavender selection.
Native system typography and familiar controls.
Original cat-and-octopus mark; cursor artwork stays the focal object.

rules.name: The Preview Surface Rule
rules.body: The Light/Dark picker changes the cursor test surfaces independently of the application's macOS appearance.

dos: Do use the native macOS system font and rounded system headings.
Do preserve each imported filename, aspect ratio, and click point.
Do distinguish selected artwork, local preview, and the arrow actually applied.
Do show selection with an outline and checkmark as well as color.
Do keep Apply and Restore reachable outside scrolling content.
donts: Don't turn ordinary buttons or focus affordances into mascot anatomy.
Don't imply that native text, hand, or resize samples are custom replacements.
Don't copy reference artwork or add website chrome to the native utility.
Don't animate or smooth pointer tracking; the click point must follow immediately.
